response.rule_text: 5 business days; one 5-business-day extension with written notice.

fees.labor_rule: Search and review time generally cannot be charged.
fees.copy_rule: First 50 pages free, then up to 15 cents per page.
fees.late_penalty: A late response forfeits copy fees.

appeal.body: Public Access Counselor (Attorney General), or circuit court
appeal.rule_text: Request for review to the Public Access Counselor within 60 days, or suit in circuit court.
